statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: packages/manager/src/components/Markdown/**, packages/manager/src/features/Marketplace/ProductDetails/**, packages/manager/.changeset/**. Do not edit forbidden paths: packages/manager/src/**/sanitize*, packages/manager/src/features/Marketplace/** (except allowed paths), packages/** (except packages/manager allowed paths), package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.

review.notes: Approved after replacing a dev-tools CSS false authority with the base app's MUI entry, ThemeProvider wrapper, and theme selection module. component:Markdown resolves uniquely to production source, the scope card is candidate-exact, and tightened guards prevent non-production rank one.
